About The Opportunity
Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 31 December 2026
Title
Senior Manager
Department
Global Capability Hub
Location
Dalian
Reports To
Director - Global Capability Hub
Level
Grade 6
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
About Your Team
Finance Services supports Financial Services, Group and some parts of Eight Roads and Canada businesses. It also includes centralized functions performed for FIL as a whole. Core activities for Financial Planning & Analysis, Financial Control and Procure to Pay are centralized with an aspiration to accelerate finance for future.
About Your Role
This is an exciting opportunity for a Japanese-speaking finance professional to join our Global Capability Hub (GCH), supporting our Japanese business while gaining significantly broader exposure across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region and our global organisation.
Fluency in Mandarin, Japanese and English is an essential requirement for the role, enabling the successful candidate to build strong relationships with Japanese stakeholders and act as an important connection between the Global Capability Hub and our business in Japan.
The role provides a unique opportunity to develop experience beyond a single market. Based within the GCH in Dalian, you will work closely with stakeholders across Japan and the wider APAC region, as well as partnering with colleagues and senior stakeholders globally. This provides excellent exposure to different markets, regulatory environments, business models, products and ways of working.
The role is centred around providing subject-matter expertise across the billing and revenue process, combining finance, accounting, reporting, data and systems knowledge with a strong focus on transformation and continuous improvement. You will have exposure to customer billing KPIs, revenue processes, stakeholder management and the ongoing development and simplification of our finance processes.
Being part of the GCH also provides the opportunity to work within a growing centre of expertise, develop a broad international network, share knowledge across markets and build experience of global processes, transformation and best practice. For a Japanese-speaking professional, this represents an excellent opportunity to use your language and market knowledge while developing a broader regional and global career within Finance.
Key Responsibilities
The roles and responsibilities will be as follows:
Process Key Results Area:
Act as a key Japanese-speaking finance contact, partnering with stakeholders in Japan and providing an effective link between the Japanese business, the Global Capability Hub and the wider global Finance organisation.
Develop strong relationships with stakeholders across Japan, APAC and global teams, building an understanding of different market requirements while supporting greater consistency in global processes.
Provide subject-matter expertise across the billing and revenue accounting lifecycle, ensuring accurate, timely and complete financial information.
Ensure accurate interfaces of revenue information into Finance Data Warehouse systems and perform revenue reconciliations to support completeness of the financial books and records.
Perform and review customer billing and revenue accounting processes for the institutional business, ensuring appropriate controls and service standards are maintained.
Liaise with upstream teams to identify and resolve data and information gaps and continually improve the quality of revenue recording and reporting.
Partner with onboarding, sales, client service and relationship teams to understand client fee arrangements and ensure they are accurately reflected within billing and revenue processes.
Produce and distribute monthly invoices and relevant dashboards in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements and stakeholder requirements.
Perform month-end accruals and reconciliations and provide high-quality revenue reporting, analysis and insight to business and Finance stakeholders.
Support financial audits, control reviews and implementation of audit recommendations, strengthening the overall risk and control environment.
Support new products, propositions and market requirements, ensuring Finance and billing processes can respond effectively to changing business needs across APAC.
Identify opportunities for process simplification, standardisation, automation and transformation, leveraging the scale and capabilities of the Global Capability Hub.
Resolve complex or escalated operational issues, coordinating effectively across functions, markets and time zones.
Contribute to the continued development of the Global Capability Hub as a centre of expertise, sharing knowledge and best practice across Japan, APAC and the wider global organisation.
Support the broader CFO transformation agenda, helping deliver improved controls, data quality, efficiency, scalability and stakeholder outcomes.
Ensures compliance with applicable policies and reviews contracts to ensure revenue is recorded as per company standards and guidelines
Capable of resolving escalated issues arising from operations and requiring coordination with other departments
Enhancing the risk and control framework supporting the process
Change Management:
Impact assessment and support on various change projects - Process specific & wider organisational projects
Regular connect with various upstream and downstream system/technology teams to communicate ongoing changes and supporting end to end automation
Usage of data visualisation tools, data analytics and other statistical techniques to solve real time business problems
Generate efficiency and drive synergies across billing, revenue and sales and assets function
Drive changes in procedures, re-define responsibilities and Key Results Areas to align with the new process definitions
About You
Experience and Qualifications Required
Qualified CA or equivalent/ MBA Finance with upto 10 years of relevant work experience in Finance with exposure to accounting, data analytics and reporting.
Understanding of revenue accounting and its downstream impact on distribution and IM business finance teams
Possess understanding of revenue solution and programme
Prior experience in FP&A, Finance control, O2C and AR roles would be an advantage.
Strong analytical skills including knowledge of accounting principles
Knowledge of the Microsoft Office software packages; Proficient with Microsoft Excel
Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau will be an advantage
Shows attention to detail and an appetite to dive into issues in depth as needed
Collaborative approach to develop, share, accept and implementation of ideas
Identify opportunities & implement solutions to improve process
Business Facing
Strong senior stakeholder management skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to challenge conventional ideas/ status quo.
Teamwork & Motivational
Able to command respect from stakeholders and peers, comfortable playing a part in management discussions.
Ability to influence and challenge.
Good communicator, able to present and articulate information succinctly.
Strong analytical skills, able to see the big picture and offer innovative solutions.
Able to multi-task and prioritise under pressure.
Capable of reviewing, designing and improving processes.
Strong team-working skills, ideally with experience of working in a matrix environment.
Understanding the complexities of working within a multi-location team.
Flexible and adaptable, responds rapidly to change.
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Title Senior Manager

Department Global Capability Hub

Location Dalian

Reports To Director - Global Capability Hub

Level Grade 6

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

About Your Team

Finance Services supports Financial Services, Group and some parts of Eight Roads and Canada businesses. It also includes centralized functions performed for FIL as a whole. Core activities for Financial Planning & Analysis, Financial Control and Procure to Pay are centralized with an aspiration to accelerate finance for future.

About Your Role

This is an exciting opportunity for a Japanese-speaking finance professional to join our Global Capability Hub (GCH), supporting our Japanese business while gaining significantly broader exposure across the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region and our global organisation.

Fluency in Mandarin, Japanese and English is an essential requirement for the role, enabling the successful candidate to build strong relationships with Japanese stakeholders and act as an important connection between the Global Capability Hub and our business in Japan.

The role provides a unique opportunity to develop experience beyond a single market. Based within the GCH in Dalian, you will work closely with stakeholders across Japan and the wider APAC region, as well as partnering with colleagues and senior stakeholders globally. This provides excellent exposure to different markets, regulatory environments, business models, products and ways of working.

The role is centred around providing subject-matter expertise across the billing and revenue process, combining finance, accounting, reporting, data and systems knowledge with a strong focus on transformation and continuous improvement. You will have exposure to customer billing KPIs, revenue processes, stakeholder management and the ongoing development and simplification of our finance processes.

Being part of the GCH also provides the opportunity to work within a growing centre of expertise, develop a broad international network, share knowledge across markets and build experience of global processes, transformation and best practice. For a Japanese-speaking professional, this represents an excellent opportunity to use your language and market knowledge while developing a broader regional and global career within Finance.

Key Responsibilities

The roles and responsibilities will be as follows:

Process Key Results Area:

  • Act as a key Japanese-speaking finance contact, partnering with stakeholders in Japan and providing an effective link between the Japanese business, the Global Capability Hub and the wider global Finance organisation.
  • Develop strong relationships with stakeholders across Japan, APAC and global teams, building an understanding of different market requirements while supporting greater consistency in global processes.
  • Provide subject-matter expertise across the billing and revenue accounting lifecycle, ensuring accurate, timely and complete financial information.
  • Ensure accurate interfaces of revenue information into Finance Data Warehouse systems and perform revenue reconciliations to support completeness of the financial books and records.
  • Perform and review customer billing and revenue accounting processes for the institutional business, ensuring appropriate controls and service standards are maintained.
  • Liaise with upstream teams to identify and resolve data and information gaps and continually improve the quality of revenue recording and reporting.
  • Partner with onboarding, sales, client service and relationship teams to understand client fee arrangements and ensure they are accurately reflected within billing and revenue processes.
  • Produce and distribute monthly invoices and relevant dashboards in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements and stakeholder requirements.
  • Perform month-end accruals and reconciliations and provide high-quality revenue reporting, analysis and insight to business and Finance stakeholders.
  • Support financial audits, control reviews and implementation of audit recommendations, strengthening the overall risk and control environment.
  • Support new products, propositions and market requirements, ensuring Finance and billing processes can respond effectively to changing business needs across APAC.
  • Identify opportunities for process simplification, standardisation, automation and transformation, leveraging the scale and capabilities of the Global Capability Hub.
  • Resolve complex or escalated operational issues, coordinating effectively across functions, markets and time zones.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the Global Capability Hub as a centre of expertise, sharing knowledge and best practice across Japan, APAC and the wider global organisation.
  • Support the broader CFO transformation agenda, helping deliver improved controls, data quality, efficiency, scalability and stakeholder outcomes.
  • Ensures compliance with applicable policies and reviews contracts to ensure revenue is recorded as per company standards and guidelines
  • Capable of resolving escalated issues arising from operations and requiring coordination with other departments
  • Enhancing the risk and control framework supporting the process

Change Management:

  • Impact assessment and support on various change projects - Process specific & wider organisational projects
  • Regular connect with various upstream and downstream system/technology teams to communicate ongoing changes and supporting end to end automation
  • Usage of data visualisation tools, data analytics and other statistical techniques to solve real time business problems
  • Generate efficiency and drive synergies across billing, revenue and sales and assets function
  • Drive changes in procedures, re-define responsibilities and Key Results Areas to align with the new process definitions

About You

Experience and Qualifications Required

  • Qualified CA or equivalent/ MBA Finance with upto 10 years of relevant work experience in Finance with exposure to accounting, data analytics and reporting.
  • Understanding of revenue accounting and its downstream impact on distribution and IM business finance teams
  • Possess understanding of revenue solution and programme
  • Prior experience in FP&A, Finance control, O2C and AR roles would be an advantage.
  • Strong analytical skills including knowledge of accounting principles
  • Knowledge of the Microsoft Office software packages; Proficient with Microsoft Excel
  • Knowledge of Power BI, Tableau will be an advantage
  • Shows attention to detail and an appetite to dive into issues in depth as needed
  • Collaborative approach to develop, share, accept and implementation of ideas
  • Identify opportunities & implement solutions to improve process

Business Facing

  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to challenge conventional ideas/ status quo.

Teamwork & Motivational

  • Able to command respect from stakeholders and peers, comfortable playing a part in management discussions.
  • Ability to influence and challenge.
  • Good communicator, able to present and articulate information succinctly.
  • Strong analytical skills, able to see the big picture and offer innovative solutions.
  • Able to multi-task and prioritise under pressure.
  • Capable of reviewing, designing and improving processes.
  • Strong team-working skills, ideally with experience of working in a matrix environment.
  • Understanding the complexities of working within a multi-location team.
  • Flexible and adaptable, responds rapidly to change.

Feel rewarded

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. Job Description
2027 CHINA SEASONAL INTERNSHIP PROGRAM - PAYMENTS INTERN OPPORTUNITY
Have you ever wondered what it means to help drive innovation across global payments and are you curious how multi-national businesses manage currencies and payments? J.P. Morgan is at the forefront of innovation in emerging financial technology that is improving cash management and payment solutions. The Payments internship program offers you the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across this exciting, innovative landscape to learn what it takes to “make money move.” With the full support and resources of J.P. Morgan, you'll have what you need to succeed – from training and mentorship from senior leaders to engagement on challenging projects that use all your skills. We are looking for out-of-the box thinkers to help us drive our future client solutions.
As a Payments Intern in the 2027 China Seasonal Internship Program, you will begin a 6-month program from July to December designed to provide a realistic career experience with the firm and exposure to top professionals across functions. Over the course of the program, you will be provided the necessary training and also learn a great deal from your colleagues and teammates. You will also get opportunities to meet senior colleagues and continue building your own professional network. You will develop essential knowledge and skills, and it is an outstanding first step towards building a dynamic, long-term career with us.
The program is an opportunity to take your career to the next level through hands-on experience, relevant skills training and valuable professional networking. Based on your individual performance and achievements, you may receive an offer of full-time employment upon completion of the internship program. The full-time offer is to join the two-year Payments rotational analyst program.
As one of the world's largest banks, J.P. Morgan moves $5 trillion each day for our clients around the world— almost 20% of the global USD market— across multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector entities. Our leadership position allows us, and requires us, to constantly innovate to stay on top and deliver for our clients.
Job Responsibilities
Learn how we work with 100,000+ clients in 150+ countries to support cash management needs and technology-based payment solutions
Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies to meet client needs

The Global Corporate Bank manages J.P. Morgan's overall relationships with large corporations and public sector organizations globally to solve problems for clients and help them to grow. We help our clients meet their objectives and challenges in financing, risk management, working capital, cash management and investments. Clients benefit from dedicated coverage provided by experienced corporate bankers, who deliver the firm's extensive product platform and presence in more than 60 countries worldwide. We leverage the capital strength of JPMorgan Chase and extend credit to help clients grow their business.
As a central part of the firm's plans to further expand its successful international banking franchise, the Global Corporate Bank offers exciting opportunities as a place to work. As an analyst, you would be required to work with other professionals as a team drawing from the full spectrum of the firm's resources to develop customized financial solutions to meet the needs of clients. Analysts work with team members of all seniority levels by assisting them with all client activities (marketing, execution and on-going relationship management). Analysts assume responsibility for managing internal processes for deal executions, internal approvals, business aspects of regulatory reporting and ongoing management of client relationship.
